Jello Cookies
By: Andie Mitchell
Published: Friday, February 12, 2010 - 3:48pm

Ingredients




1 cup Butter or margerine
1 cup Sugar
1 pkt Jello flavor of your choice
1 teaspoon Vanilla
1 teaspoon Baking powder
4 cups Flour
1 Egg

Preparation

1 Whisk flour and baking powder in a bowl and set aside. In a separate bowl, cream butter. Beat in the sugar, jello, egg, and vanilla. Then stir in the dry ingredients. The dough should be fairly stiff. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour. Roll out like you would any other sugar cookie and cut shapes. Place on a greased cookie sheet and bake 10 minutes at 375 (keep a close eye on them). Decorate with colored sugar or glaze.
